name: MonarchMegaMenu
title: MegaMenu
wrapsNative: Buttons in a MonarchFlowLayout; .popover with .presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover) for each panel; openURL for links
summary: Site-style navigation for a product's public, help or tour screens: a row of entries, where an entry with groups opens a panel of grouped links with symbols, descriptions and badges, and an optional featured card.
whenToUse: For a band of destinations that need a description each, such as a help centre, a product tour or the public screens of an app.
whenNotToUse: For an app's top-level navigation, use a TabView or NavigationSplitView. For a few actions on one object, use a Menu. For settings, use a List.
api: init(items: [MonarchMegaMenuItem], openItem: Binding<String?>? = nil, exploreLabel: String? = nil, onNavigate: (@MainActor (MonarchMegaMenuLink) -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchMegaMenuItem.init(_ id: String, label: String, groups: [MonarchMegaMenuGroup], featured: MonarchMegaMenuLink? = nil)
MonarchMegaMenuItem.init(_ id: String, label: String, destination: URL?)
MonarchMegaMenuLink.init(_ label: String, destination: URL? = nil, description: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, badge: String? = nil, isExternal: Bool = false)

options.name: items
options.description: The top-level entries: menus with groups and a featured card, or plain links.

options.name: openItem
options.description: The id of the entry whose panel is open. Without it the menu keeps its own.

options.name: exploreLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Explore" action of the featured card and the hint of a menu entry.

options.name: onNavigate
options.description: Called with the chosen link; without it the link's destination opens with openURL.

states.name: closed
states.description: A row of entries; a menu entry has a down chevron.

states.name: open
states.description: The entry is filled and its chevron turned; its panel is a popover under it with the groups and the featured card.

states.name: link
states.description: A link row with a symbol tile, a badge, a description and, for an external link, an outward arrow.

appearance: Entries use the label role, muted until open. Group headings are captions in small capitals in the muted colour; link titles are bold body text, descriptions muted; symbol tiles use the subtle background with the accent's strong colour; badges use the accent tone. The panel uses the raised background and the featured card the subtle one. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web MegaMenu opens panels on hover with a delay, as a disclosure navigation with columns, and as a menu dialog on narrow screens. iOS has no hover: an entry opens its panel on tap, as a popover under it on iPhone and iPad, and it closes when a link is chosen or with a tap outside. Groups stack in one column. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: Each entry is a button; a menu entry has the hint "Explore".
Group headings have the header trait.
Each link is one button read as its title, its badge and its description; an external link also has the link trait.
The featured card is one button with the hint "Explore".
Symbols are decorative and hidden from VoiceOver.
edgeCases: Many entries wrap onto a second row; keep the entries few.
A tall panel scrolls within the popover's height.
A link with neither a destination nor onNavigate does nothing when chosen.

examples.title: Product site header
examples.code:
MonarchMegaMenu(items: [
    MonarchMegaMenuItem("product", label: "Product", groups: [
        MonarchMegaMenuGroup("Plan", links: [
            MonarchMegaMenuLink("Projects", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/projects"), description: "Track work from idea to launch", systemImage: "square.grid.2x2"),
            MonarchMegaMenuLink("Calendar", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/calendar"), description: "Deadlines and milestones in one view", systemImage: "calendar", badge: "New"),
        ]),
        MonarchMegaMenuGroup("Collaborate", links: [
            MonarchMegaMenuLink("Teams", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/teams"), description: "Roles, access and ownership", systemImage: "person.2"),
            MonarchMegaMenuLink("Settings", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/settings"), description: "Workspace preferences", systemImage: "gearshape"),
        ]),
    ], featured: MonarchMegaMenuLink(
        "What changed this month",
        destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/changelog"),
        description: "A short tour of the newest features and fixes.",
        systemImage: "square.grid.2x2",
        badge: "Updated"
    )),
    MonarchMegaMenuItem("company", label: "Company", groups: [
        MonarchMegaMenuGroup("About", links: [
            MonarchMegaMenuLink("Who we are", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/about"), description: "The team and how we work"),
            MonarchMegaMenuLink("Status", destination: URL(string: "https://status.example.com"), description: "Service health", isExternal: true),
        ]),
    ]),
    MonarchMegaMenuItem("support", label: "Support", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/support")),
], openItem: $openItem)
.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
